geometry.classification: Conditional geometry; no state-to-loop or flow law adopted

equations.quarterturn: Q about radial line O+t*u_j, t real; pivot B_j (on same line); u_j fixed, v_j->e_z, e_z->-v_j
equations.tube_domain: 0<tau<R and tau<dist(Gamma_j,accepted shell); positive clearance exists; no thickness selected
equations.loop_count: Only P0 carrier drawn. P1/P2 records are symmetry-related alternatives, not three adopted physical loops

state_counterexample.source_noise: zero; optional old measurement noise is not applied
state_counterexample.history: single-row algebraic records, not generated histories

paired_geometry.changes: Orthographic camera, separate median section, labels and line styles; exact geometry unchanged.

full_modules.changes: Enlarged view of existing site 0, no resized physical fixture; annotations are frame vectors.

hr_controls.changes: Two separate orthographic panels, common middle ring in blue. Complete 18-vertex modules, no HxR product.

fixture.description: Two algebraic states at one fixed clock, not consecutive trajectory states

state_contrast.changes: Only retained chirality-component differences plotted; line segments guide the fixed-site pattern.

delay_comparison.changes: Analytic curves as functions of differential phase only; fixed onset values. No evolved history.
